def apply(inputs, premises):
    component = inputs['component_id']
    view = inputs['view']
    public = inputs['public_case']
    facts = []
    witnesses = list(view.get('witnesses', []))
    reasons = []
    complete = True
    if type(view) is not dict or view.get('extraction_status') != 'complete':
        return part([], [], [], False, ['retained_context_unread'])
    residences = view.get('residences')
    births = view.get('births')
    if type(residences) is not list or type(births) is not list or type(view.get('witnesses')) is not list:
        return part([], [], [], False, ['retained_context_channels_unread'])
    for index, record in enumerate(residences):
        evidence = checked(record, public, True)
        persons = record.get('persons')
        location = record.get('location')
        term = record.get('residence_term')
        start = record.get('start_date')
        start_text = record.get('start_text')
        end = record.get('end_date')
        end_text = record.get('end_text')
        valid_start = start is None and start_text is None or (type(start) is str and type(start_text) is str)
        valid_end = end is None and end_text is None or (type(end) is str and type(end_text) is str)
        if evidence is None or type(persons) is not list or len(persons) == 0 or (not all((type(x) is str for x in persons))) or (type(location) is not str) or (type(term) is not str) or (not valid_start) or (not valid_end):
            complete = False
            continue
        quote = ' '.join((row['quote'].lower() for row in evidence))
        if term.lower() not in quote or location.lower() not in quote or (not all((person.lower() in quote for person in persons))) or (type(start_text) is str and start_text.lower() not in quote) or (type(end_text) is str and end_text.lower() not in quote):
            complete = False
            continue
        for row in evidence:
            add(witnesses, row)
        for position, person in enumerate(persons):
            event = 'residence_' + str(index) + '_' + str(position)
            put(facts, 'residence_', [event])
            put(facts, 'agent_', [event, person])
            put(facts, 'patient_', [event, location])
            if type(start) is str:
                put(facts, 'start_', [event, start])
            if type(end) is str:
                put(facts, 'end_', [event, end])
    for index, record in enumerate(births):
        evidence = checked(record, public, True)
        person = record.get('person')
        term = record.get('birth_term')
        date = record.get('birth_date')
        date_text = record.get('date_text')
        if evidence is None or type(person) is not str or term not in ('born', 'birth', 'date of birth') or (type(date) is not str) or (type(date_text) is not str):
            complete = False
            continue
        quote = ' '.join((row['quote'].lower() for row in evidence))
        if person.lower() not in quote or term.lower() not in quote or date_text.lower() not in quote:
            complete = False
            continue
        for row in evidence:
            add(witnesses, row)
        event = 'birth_' + str(index)
        put(facts, 'birth_', [event])
        put(facts, 'agent_', [event, person])
        put(facts, 'start_', [event, date])
    if not complete:
        add(reasons, component + '_one_or_more_records_unread_or_invalid')
    return part(facts, [], witnesses, complete, reasons)
